name: Product Details
description:
## Product Details
A customizable component that allows for flexible design and layout of individual product page templates. Showcase product images, descriptions, pricing, specifications, call-to-action buttons, and more in a way that best suits a particular set of products.

tooltip.content: "Auto": Client-side only. JavaScript builds the JSON-LD after the product loads, so it is not in the page source. "Fragment": Server-side + client-side. The selected fragment renders into the page source, then is refreshed client-side from the JSON API. "None": No structured data is output.
tooltip.title: Structured Data

tooltip.content: Optional. Select a fragment that outputs a JSON object. The component requests it with the product (and again for each selected variant) and applies recognized keys: quantity_limits.min and quantity_limits.max. Leave empty for default behavior.
tooltip.title: Advanced Data Fragment
